fields.title: Design for lag
fields.inputs/2/label: Stock quantity on add to cart
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The replica lags by 2–8 seconds. For each screen, decide: read from leader, read from replica, or make a product decision.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: User order feed immediately after checkout
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Stock quantity when adding to cart
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Feed — product decision, read from leader window for 30 seconds after write. Catalog — replica, lag is unnoticeable. Stock — leader, error costs more than load. Counter — product decision, calculated on the client, which already knows about the tap. Rating — replica, no one knows what it was a second ago. General rule: ask not «is the data fresh», but «will the person notice their specific action».
